title: Room journal lifecycle recording under the shared lock

claims.text: agent_lifecycle requires room, agent, state and run_id, rejects unknown keys, checks room and agent, generates a random op_id when absent, and validates the op shape with PlanError mapped to RoomError.

_commit serializes through the room lock, replays a matching op_id (bad_op on room, op or batch conflict), folds the op with fold_plan and apply_op_event, appends one canonical event line, and refuses beyond the room CAP with room_full.

agent_lifecycle trusts no client clock: ts is resolved only after acquiring the shared lock, and the registered agent_lifecycle tool accepts exactly the room, agent, state, run_id, swarm, harness, reason and op_id arguments.

decision.rule: Change here when room lifecycle argument validation, op replay, or lifecycle append under the room lock needs to change.
decision.failure: The same lifecycle op appends twice, a conflicting op_id passes, or client-supplied timestamps are honored.

questions.q: Where does _commit deduplicate lifecycle ops by op_id under the room lock?
Where should I change the lifecycle tool input schema?
Where can I debug why a lifecycle append fails with room_full?
